pages.text: $(l)CPR$(): hold right-click with an empty hand on a downed player and press $(l)space$() in rhythm (mark in the centre). Good CPR keeps the brain oxygenated and sometimes ($(cfg)15%$()) restarts the heart.
$(l)Ambu bag$() — breathe for a patient who does not. Same rhythm. Raises SpO₂ higher than without it.
